title: Gunter for a Day
synopsis: A wish gone wrong swaps Ice King and Gunter, and Gunter turns out to be a much better Ice King.
plot:
Ice King, frustrated that Gunter never listens to him, finds a wishing rock in the ice and wishes that Gunter would understand what it's like to be him. The rock takes this literally. Ice King wakes up as a small penguin, and Gunter is now wearing the crown.

Gunter is immediately excellent at it. He does not kidnap any princesses. He sends the Candy Kingdom a polite note. He organizes the penguins into a functioning household. Princesses begin visiting the Ice Kingdom voluntarily, which has never happened. Ice King, as a penguin, watches all of this from the floor and is furious, then heartbroken, then, slowly, impressed.

Finn and Jake arrive expecting a crisis and instead find Wildberry Princess having tea. The problem is that the crown is starting to affect Gunter, whose eyes are going pale. Ice King, tiny and waddling, climbs up Gunter's back and takes the crown off with his beak, wishing everything back. Restored, he asks Gunter how he did it. Gunter says 'wenk'. Ice King writes it down.
transcriptText:
Ice King: Gunter! Gunter, are you even listening to me?
Gunter: Wenk.
Ice King: That's not an answer! I wish you knew what it was like to be me!
[The wishing rock glows. FLASH.]
Ice King: [now a penguin] ...Wenk?
Gunter: [wearing the crown, in a deep voice] Wenk.
[The Candy Kingdom. A Banana Guard delivers a letter.]
Princess Bubblegum: [reading] 'Dear Princess, I will not be kidnapping you this week. Regards, the Ice King.' ...Huh.
[Ice Kingdom. Penguins march in orderly lines.]
Ice King: [as a penguin] This is a disgrace! I— wenk! Stop making me wenk!
Wildberry Princess: This tea is lovely, Ice King.
Gunter: Wenk.
Wildberry Princess: You're so much more relaxed lately.
Ice King: [on the floor] SHE CAME HERE VOLUNTARILY? THAT NEVER HAPPENS.
[Finn and Jake burst in.]
Finn: Ice King! Whatever you're doing, stop— oh. Hi, Wildberry.
Wildberry Princess: Hello, boys! Have a scone.
Jake: [eating a scone] What's going on here.
Ice King: [as a penguin, tugging Finn's pant leg] Wenk! Wenk wenk wenk!
Finn: Is this... Ice King?
Ice King: WENK.
Jake: Dude, he's doing a way better job than you.
Ice King: [dejected] Wenk.
Finn: Wait. Look at Gunter's eyes.
[Gunter's eyes are going pale and cold.]
Jake: The crown's getting him.
Ice King: [climbing up Gunter's back] No. No no no. Not you. Not you too.
[He grabs the crown in his beak and pulls it off. FLASH.]
Ice King: [restored] Gunter! Gunter, are you okay?
Gunter: Wenk.
Ice King: How did you do it? The princesses, the tea, the— how?
Gunter: Wenk.
Ice King: [writing it down] 'Wenk.' Got it.
